english.note: This is the all-purpose word for a relative connected by blood, marriage, or adoption.
Use this specifically for a family member or relative, rather than for a general relationship.
Use this for the non-parent relatives when “folks” means one's extended family.

examples.english: We visit a relative during Chinese New Year.
examples.jyutping: gwo3 nin4 ngo5 dei6 wui5 heoi3 taam3 can1 cik1

examples.english: He’s a distant relation of mine.
examples.jyutping: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 jyun5 fong2 can1 cik1

examples.english: My folk often come to my place for dinner during the New Year.
examples.traditional: 我啲親戚過年成日嚟我屋企食飯。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 di1 can1 cik1 gwo3 nin4 seng4 jat6 lei4 ngo5 uk1 kei2 sik6 faan6
